title: RecoveryRecorded v1
description: recovery received and approved. Slice 4 (D-SL4-06): published when CLM records received cash for a salvage, subrogation or Friendly Settlement recovery from an evidence-backed system set (BIL allocation). Fields marked always-set are always set by CLM.

businessKeys.description: Lineage keys this event must carry (D5, D-CON-01, D-CON-28). 'a|b' in x-business-keys means at least one of them.

recoveryType.description: Recovery type (open Code): SALVAGE, SUBROGATION or FRIENDLY_SETTLEMENT in slice 4

allocationByLine.description: Recovery received per reserve line (ClaimPaymentLine is a superset of LineAmount, so v1.0 instances stay valid): lineKey = the CLM financial transaction id, amount in three currencies, reserveLineId, exposureId, costType, costCategory. CLM always fills every member (SL4-CONTRACTS, PITFALLS 12).

claimId.description: Claim (the aggregate id, repeated so FIN and RI post from payload fields only); CLM always sets it

accountingDate.description: Accounting date of the recovery transaction (ClaimFinancialTransaction.accounting_date); CLM always sets it

receivableId.description: BIL receivable the cash settled (D-SL4-06). Always set for SALVAGE and SUBROGATION, null otherwise

fsStatementId.description: CLM Friendly Settlement statement the recovery belongs to. Always set for FRIENDLY_SETTLEMENT, null otherwise

evidenceRef.description: Evidence of the system-recorded set: the BIL allocation id, or the FS statement line reference. Always set (client amounts are never accepted, PITFALLS 7)
